title: 2019-05-27 MoM AWS accounts and cost overview
content:
Date

Attendees

  • veronica.pettersson@ikea.com, INGKA Cloud Services 

Goals

Define next step in having better control over IPEX AWS accounts ant their related costs.

Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes
5min

What IPEX accounts exists?

What are related costs?

Real time access


Name

AWS has segregated accounts and do not inherently provide an overview of several accounts.

One way to get an overview can be to collect and aggregate data e.g. via a lambda function.

API uses that use API keys for accessing accounts can have access to several accounts.

Users that have access to AWS console must have MFA enabled and would probably not be the solution for the overview information that is requested.

Cloud services has a manually updated list of accounts so it would make sense to align IPEX and cloud service lists.

When account lists have been created some basic cost monitoring should be set up using the identified accounts.

Used accounts could then indirectly identified by associated consists.
